tldr: Sun in the 3rd house: identity and vitality center on communication and daily life
body: Sun in the 3rd house: identity and vitality center on communication and daily life. Gift: you shine there. Watch: ego tied to it. With the Sun in the 3rd house, identity, vitality, visibility, and the need to live from a clear center move through communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement. This makes how you speak, study, write, listen, and move through the immediate world a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose. Left unconscious, it can become over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth.
gift: presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose expressed through voice and daily mind.
challenge: over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth concentrated in voice and daily mind.
note: Merged with approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
